name: vibooks
description: AI bookkeeping for small businesses, from source documents to reconciled books.

interface.shortDescription: AI bookkeeping from source documents to reconciled books
interface.longDescription: Turn receipts, bills, invoices, and bank or card statements into source-linked bookkeeping in Vibooks. Set up books, record transactions through proper workflows, reconcile accounts, review exceptions, and prepare month-end reports with your own AI agent. Books stay on your device by default, and writes remain controlled and reviewable.
defaultPrompt: Set up Vibooks on this computer and verify it is ready for bookkeeping.
Record the receipts, bills, invoices, and statements in this folder in Vibooks.
Reconcile my bank and card statements and prepare a month-end review.
